name: Julia McCurry
title: Psychologist
description: Her work is grounded in a trauma-informed framework. Julia has supported people with complex, high-risk presentations, often alongside significant trauma histories. She draws on Schema Therapy (ST), CBT, ACT and DBT.

name: Steven Tsolakis
title: Psychologist
description: His areas of clinical interest include trauma and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD and complex PTSD), depression, anxiety and OCD. He takes a person-centred, neuroaffirming and trauma-informed approach, welcoming LGBTQIA+ individuals. Approaches include CPT for PTSD, DBT, ACT, Schema Therapy and Narrative Therapy.
specialties: trauma, complex PTSD, LGBTQIA+, schema therapy, CPT, OCD

name: Tara Fang
title: Psychologist
description: She has worked with clients affected by developmental trauma, sexual trauma, family violence and systemic adversities. She draws on CBT, Cognitive Processing Therapy (CPT) for PTSD, ACT, DBT, Schema Therapy, and Compassion-Focused Therapy.
specialties: trauma, PTSD, sexual trauma, schema therapy, CPT, family violence

name: Genevieve Dorman
title: Psychologist
description: She provides trauma-informed treatment and has clinical and research interests in trauma, post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) and neurodiversity, working with complex trauma and PTSD.
specialties: complex trauma, PTSD, neurodiversity, chronic illness

name: Dr Evan Chachos
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Evan maintains a strong focus in understanding how trauma affects the way we think about, and navigate, day to day life. He is an accredited provider of cognitive processing therapy (CPT) for trauma-related distress and posttraumatic stress.
specialties: trauma, PTSD, CPT, anxiety, sleep, bipolar

name: Ambreen Mirza
title: Psychologist
description: She brings a strong commitment to trauma-informed care. Her clinical work spans childhood trauma, sexual abuse, refugee and migration trauma, family violence and eating disorders, and she has trained clinicians in trauma-focused CBT.
specialties: childhood trauma, sexual abuse, refugee trauma, family violence, trauma-focused CBT

name: Dr Sarah Stewart
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Works with births experienced as traumatic and with non birth related trauma. Her approach to treatment is relational and is informed by attachment theory and Schema Therapy.
specialties: perinatal, birth trauma, trauma, schema therapy

name: Dr Jon Finch
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Jon works with his clients using Cognitive Processing Therapy (CPT) for PTSD and trauma. Jon is also a certified individual Schema Therapist with the International Society of Schema Therapy, and has worked in private practice since 2011 with a focus upon treating people with complex trauma histories.
specialties: schema therapy, complex trauma, PTSD, CPT

name: Dr Emma Symes
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Skilled in the provision of treatments for trauma, anxiety, depression. Emma is trained in a range of therapies including CBT, Schema Therapy, Cognitive Processing Therapy (CPT) for PTSD, DBT and more.

name: Stephanie Dias
title: Psychologist
description: She works with adults across a range of life challenges including depression, anxiety, trauma, identity and relationship issues and procrastination.

name: Jodi Clarke
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Jodi is a clinical psychologist with over 20 years of experience working in the public and private sectors providing psychological care to clients experiencing anxiety, depression, trauma, addictions and adjustment problems.

name: Jodie Mattingley
title: Psychologist
description: To address trauma I often use cognitive processing therapy (CPT), and Schema therapy. I am also trained in EMDR which I use when treating trauma and related mental health conditions.

name: Alex Schubert
title: Psychologist
description: I work with adults experiencing a broad range of concerns, including ADHD, Depression, Anxiety, Trauma, Career Direction and Addiction. My work is informed by CBT, ACT, DBT, and Schema Therapy.

name: Jonathan Norton
title: Counselling Psychologist
description: He is an LGBTQIA+ friendly and neurodiversity affirming practitioner.
specialties: LGBTQIA+ friendly, neurodiversity affirming, counselling psychology

name: Nadia Rakiposki
title: Relationships Counsellor, Family Therapist and Accredited Mental Health Social Worker
description: Nadia is a proud LGBTQIA+ and neurodiversity-affirming practitioner, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive space. Nadia supports couples facing challenges such as infidelity, trauma, grief, and uses a systemic and trauma-informed approach.
specialties: LGBTQIA+ affirming, couples, family therapy, trauma, narrative therapy

name: Dagmara Rowlands
title: Relationships Counsellor and Accredited Mental Health Social Worker
description: Dagmara supports couples through a range of underlying issues, including trauma, addictions, bereavement, and anger problems. Approaches include Eye movement desensitisation and reprocessing EMDR, CBT, Emotion Focused Therapy (EFT) and Self-compassion.

name: Jennifer Poole
title: Psychotherapist/Counsellor and Accredited Mental Health Social Worker
description: Works with clients experiencing trauma and change of life scenarios.
